Academic milestones

Academic work develops through a sequence of education, research assistance, fieldwork, data analysis, and independent research. Each stage contributes different skills and helps shape the questions that I want to study.

This section records important developments in that process. The purpose is to maintain a simple record of research related activities, rather than to provide a conventional curriculum vitae.
